meta.title: Independent re-verification of the five submitted links
meta.method: Each submitted URL was requested a second time, by a different session, in the same day. Redirects were followed and the destination page's own title and breadcrumb were read. Values below are transcribed from what the destination returned. Nothing was inferred, and no price, rating or review count was recorded because publishing those requires a feed this project does not have.
meta.why_two_passes: Two earlier sessions published contradictory registers: one claimed three of the five links reached only the Amazon homepage, another could not reach Amazon at all and left every field blank. A third register matched the destinations below. Only a fresh fetch can settle it, so this session fetched again.
meta.note_on_instability: link.amazon responses are not stable from request to request: the same URL returned a bot interstitial for one session and a product page for another. A destination recorded here is an observation, not a guarantee, and it is not an Affiliate Special Link.

pass_2026_11_20_0640.method: Each of the five supplied short links was requested once, redirects followed, final URL and page title recorded. The five destination listings were then requested directly and their titles and breadcrumbs read.
pass_2026_11_20_0640.short_link_result: All five arrived at https://www.amazon.com/ — the storefront home page. None reached a product page. This is the third distinct behaviour recorded for the same five URLs on 2026-11-20, and it agrees with FLG-028.
pass_2026_11_20_0640.listing_result: All five destination listings loaded with titles matching this register exactly: B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH, B0DHZTCNR5, B0DZFD6R9Z.
pass_2026_11_20_0640.not_claimed: No price, rating or stock figure is recorded even though the pages displayed them: publishing those requires an Amazon-served or API-served feed (Program Policies 2(b)). No intended ASIN is inferred from any redirect.

summary.conclusion: Every submitted path code is 9 characters long. Amazon's own Catalog Items reference treats an ASIN as the item identifier, and every destination ASIN observed on these pages is 10 characters; none of the five supplied codes can be matched to a catalog ASIN as written. The slug is therefore recorded as a short-link path code, never as an intended ASIN.
summary.attribution_conclusion: None of the five submitted URLs carries a tag parameter, and each works by redirect through an intermediate host. Under the Associates Commission Income Statement, purchases arriving through a Redirecting Link, or through a link that is not properly formatted, are disqualified — so as submitted these links cannot be attributed to the tracking ID. Replacing them with Special Links generated in Associates Central is the single highest-value change available to this project.
summary.cross_session_agreement: Two independent passes on 2026-11-20 reached the same four product destinations and the same unresolved fifth row. A third session's log disagrees about P-04 on some attempts. The register therefore publishes each destination as a dated observation with its source, and the weekly audit exists to notice when one changes.
